english translation text: WHEN IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S.) SAW THE BODY OF QASIM

arabic text: LASHA QASIM KA NAZAR AYA HASAN YAAD AYE
english translation text: IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) REMEMBERED HIS BROTHER IMAM HASAN (A.S) WHEN HE SAW THE BODY OF QASIM

arabic text: USS GHARI ROYE BOHOT SHEH KO HASSAN YAAD AYE
english translation text: IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S.) CRIED A LOT AS HE REMEMBERED IMAM HASAN (A.S.)

arabic text: HAYE QASIM NA TERE TUKDE BADAN KE HOTE\nRO KE SEENE SE LAGAYA TO HASSAN YAAD AYE
english translation text: I WISH YOUR BODY HAD NOT BEEN CUT IN THIS WAY,\nWHEN IMAM HUSAIN (A.S.) PUT QASIM ON HIS CHEST HE REMEMBERED IMAM HASAN (A.S.)

arabic text: TUKDE QASIM KE CHUNE AUR ABA ME DAALE\nBAAND KAR LASHA UTHAYA TO HASSAN YAAD AYE
english translation text: IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S.) PICKED THE PIECES OF QASIM’S BODY AND PLACED IT IN CLOTH,\nHE TIED THE CLOTH AND REMEMBERED HASSAN

arabic text: FAYZ SHABBIR JO QASIM KA JANAZA LAYE\nZAKHMI TEERO KE JANAZE ME HASSAN YAAD AYE
english translation text: HE REMEMBERED IMAM HASAN’S (A.S.) WOUNDED BODY COVERED IN ARROWS\nWHEN IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S.) BROUGHT THE BODY OF QASIM,
